mandatoryChecks.description: Every JSON file must parse without syntax errors, trailing commas, or invalid formatting.
No duplicate IDs exist within any entity namespace (regions, monsters, skills, drop tables, npcs, spawns, quests, items).
Every referenced entity ID across 13 cross-reference relationships must resolve.
Safe zones contain 0 monster spawns; coordinates are within region bounds; Temple of Job Advancement is accessible through safe route.
Quests form an unbroken, acyclic Lv.1 to Lv.15 progression leading to Asica with valid objectives, monsters, and rewards.
Monster stats scale smoothly; drop rates are bounded between 0 and 100%; rewards reflect appropriate level milestones.
